name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.landing.read.SpeechVoiceReadPaperCopyLinkActivity
description: When an article in a Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK reading offer cannot open in the built-in reader, this page plays a guide and explains how to copy the reading link and continue in WeChat.
disableEffect: Blocking it removes the WeChat link fallback, so users may not finish this reading ad or earn its reward.
